sources.title: szl-forge/frontier/qwen35-receiptagent-v2 at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: It pins the Apache-2.0 Qwen/Qwen3.5-.8B lineage and the exact Unsloth implementation revision used on the RTX 5050 laptop. The first gate performs a real CUDA tensor operation, loads the 0.8B checkpoint in 4-bit mode, and runs a bounded local generation. Its report remains outside Git because it is host-specific execution evidence.
